quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: It is tempting to read Naila's much-publicized digital detox, during which she claims to have abstained entirely from social media for a full year, as a straightforward story of disciplined abstinence, yet a more precise account reveals a considerably more qualified reality: she continued to use a messaging app for coordinating with family and retained access to a single professional networking platform she deemed necessary for her freelance work, meaning the detox, properly understood, extended only to platforms she categorized as primarily recreational rather than to digital communication as a whole. She has since acknowledged that the popular framing of her experience as total abstinence was, in retrospect, an oversimplification she did little to correct at the time.
quests.question: Naila's digital detox extended only to platforms she considered primarily recreational, not to all digital communication.
quests.hint: Check exactly which platforms the detox applied to, according to the more precise account.
quests.explanation: The passage confirms the detox applied only to recreational platforms, not all digital communication, so this is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: The certification board's public statement attributing this year's notably higher pass rate entirely to a revised, more effective study guide it released eighteen months ago omits a detail that internal minutes from the board's own quality committee make explicit: the same revision cycle also included a quiet recalibration of the passing threshold itself, lowered by a small but non-trivial margin after several previous cohorts had underperformed against a threshold the committee's own psychometricians had privately flagged as miscalibrated, meaning the improved pass rate reflects, at least in part, a change to the scoring standard rather than solely improved preparation materials.
quests.question: The certification board's internal minutes confirm the higher pass rate resulted solely and entirely from the improved study guide.
quests.hint: Check whether the internal minutes point to any factor besides the study guide.
quests.explanation: The passage says the minutes reveal a lowered passing threshold also contributed, so solely the study guide is false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Executives have repeatedly cited the company's remarkably smooth transition to a four-day work week in media interviews as proof of the model's viability, yet this official account tends to omit a detail that is nonetheless documented in internal planning memos: the pilot was deliberately limited to three departments whose work was, by the company's own internal assessment prior to the pilot, least dependent on real-time coordination with external clients across differing time zones, meaning the transition's apparent smoothness may reflect the careful selection of favorable conditions at least as much as the underlying viability of the model across the company as a whole.
quests.question: Internal memos confirm the pilot departments were deliberately selected because their work was least dependent on real-time external coordination.
quests.hint: Check what internal planning memos reveal about why those departments were chosen.
quests.explanation: The passage confirms this deliberate selection is documented in internal memos, so this statement is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.question: The airline's own internal report confirms the boarding procedure alone, independent of any other change, accounted for the majority of the delay reduction.
quests.hint: Check what the internal report actually attributes the majority of the improvement to.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.question: Letters uncovered through genealogical research revealed the couple had been formally introduced roughly a year before the train station encounter.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.question: The satisfaction survey methodology captures customer experiences well past the one-year mark, when most structural complaints emerge.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.question: The company's own internal audit confirms the new encryption protocol alone, independent of any other change, explains the entire reduction in breaches.
quests.hint: Check whether the internal audit credits only the encryption protocol for the reduction.

quests.question: The cited study used a dosage substantially higher than what is actually contained in the commercially sold product.

quests.question: Researchers found that a small percentage of cells do not survive freezing even in frogs that overall recover successfully.
quests.hint: Check what researchers found about cell survival during the freezing process.

quests.question: The city's own economic development office data confirms the tax incentive program alone, independent of any other factor, produced the entire decline in vacancy.

quests.question: Farid has definitively proven, through rigorous analysis, that his expense tracking alone caused his improved financial position.

quests.question: A more granular analysis found the quality improvement was concentrated mainly among students also enrolled in a peer-tutoring program.

quests.question: The incident data confirms the decline began only after the mentorship program's rollout, exactly matching leadership's public account.

quests.question: A safety certification disclosure revealed the boiler and braking systems were substantially modernized, despite marketing describing the original specifications.
quests.hint: Check what the safety certification disclosure actually revealed about the boiler and braking systems.

quests.question: Estate documentation confirmed the grandfather's business was established entirely through his own resources with no outside financial assistance.

quests.question: The investigation found the verification badge's criteria did not actually require anything relating to product defect rates or description accuracy.

quests.question: The company's own regulatory filings confirm the formula has genuinely remained essentially unchanged since the original nineteen-sixties version.
quests.hint: Check what the company's own regulatory filings actually document about the formula.

quests.question: Independent research demonstrated the facial recognition system could be circumvented under narrow conditions in a way the fingerprint sensor could not.
quests.hint: Check what the independent research actually demonstrated about the two security methods.

quests.question: The hospital network's public statement fully disclosed that the automated reminder rollout accounted for a comparable share of the improvement.

quests.question: A leaked internal document revealed the average viewer, by a more conventional completion measure, watched considerably less than half the season.
quests.hint: Check what the leaked internal document revealed about average viewer completion.

quests.question: Biologists have reached full, unanimous agreement with no remaining dispute about which organism holds the title of oldest living organism.

quests.question: A more detailed internal analysis found much of the apparent ridership growth reflects existing riders shifting from a discontinued route rather than genuinely new users.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.question: Timestamp data revealed Camille's journaling actually happens between her first and second coffee, not immediately upon waking.

quests.question: The independent review found accelerated-track graduates scored equally well as standard-track graduates on all competency measures.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.question: The recent conversation revealed the immigration decision was made before Priya or her siblings were born.
